# 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord) - 爱词霸英语

> > English-Chinese dictionary platform featuring the complete Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner's Dictionary integrated with Kingsoft's language learning tools.

This site (cp.iciba.com) serves as the partnership portal for 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord/iciba), showcasing the collaboration with Collins Publishing and 外研社 (Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press) to deliver comprehensive bilingual dictionary resources and English learning tools to Chinese users.

## Key Topics

- 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord)
- 爱词霸 (iciba)
- 柯林斯COBUILD高阶英汉双解学习词典 (Collins COBUILD Advanced)
- Collins Dictionary
- 外研社 (FLTRP)
- Bank of English corpus
- Bilingual dictionary
- English learning tools
- Grammar labels and word frequency
- Vocabulary study
- Dictionary integration
- 新东方 (New Oriental)
- 北京外国语大学 (BFSU)

## Collins Dictionary Integration

- [金山词霸完整收录《柯林斯COBUILD高阶英汉双解学习词典》](https://cp.iciba.com/collins/): Main page showcasing the complete integration of Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner's Dictionary with Kingsoft PowerWord products
- [柯林斯词典使用指南](https://cp.iciba.com/collins/introduction/): Comprehensive user guide for Collins dictionary features, including grammar labels, word frequency indicators, and usage notes
